HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

  • Identify sales opportunities that address specific needs for our clients and managing from identification to point of sale and through post trade process
  • Service a portfolio of Strategic and/or Focus clients, including Transactional clients where required
  • Manage and develop relationships with transactional clients, including those serviced over e-platforms for flow based business.
  • Provide day to day sales coverage using the full suite of Corporate Sales offerings and support team members to do the same
  • Deliver services and solutions that meet client needs and where necessary leverage the bank’s depth of product expertise and Thought Leadership
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients to drive revenue growth and greater product penetration

  • Well versed with Global Markets and relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
  • Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in East China will be preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills both in Chinese and English with very strong people interaction ability
  • Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs
  • Ability to explore business network, acquire and on-board new client names

Job Summary

This role could be based in Malaysia or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

  • Own the discovery, definition and delivery of change for the Wealth Management Core Platform, with primary focus on the Unit Trust System (UTS) and its upstream and downstream integrations.
  • Translate business, operational and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, change requests, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
  • Act as the accountable bridge between country business teams, operations, technology chapters, external vendors and dependent platforms throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Drive outcomes from requirement clarification and solution assessment through design sign-off, testing, release readiness, production deployment and post-release monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Delivery

  • Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring initiatives, epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria are clear, prioritised and traceable to business outcomes.
  • Lead requirement discovery and validation with Product, Operations and country stakeholders; identify gaps, challenge assumptions and establish an agreed scope and baseline.
  • Prepare and manage change requests, review vendor responses and functional specifications, resolve open questions, secure stakeholder approvals and provide formal sign-off when requirements are satisfied.
  • Coordinate with engineering, architecture, quality assurance, production engineering, vendors and dependent application teams to assess solutions, manage dependencies and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Plan and support SIT, UAT and business validation; track evidence and defects, secure sign-off, assess release readiness and support deployment and post-production monitoring.
  • Manage delivery risks, scope, priorities, milestones and regulatory deadlines; communicate decisions, trade-offs, dependencies and escalation needs clearly to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Build sufficient functional and technical understanding of UTS, interfaces, data mappings, reports and operational processes to facilitate effective solution discussions and make informed product decisions.
  • Maintain clear delivery documentation and governance records in the agreed collaboration and work-management tools, and drive continuous improvement in product and delivery practices.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Ownership and Backlog Management
  • Requirements Analysis and User Story Definition
  • Stakeholder, Vendor and Dependency Management
  • Agile Delivery, Testing and Release Governance

Other Skills

  • Wealth Management Products and Operations
  • Application Interfaces, Data Mapping and Reporting
  • Risk, Regulatory and Controls Awareness
  • Written and Verbal Communication
  • SQL, Python, shell scripting and basic programming (advantageous)
  • Automation through AI

Motivations

  • Motivated by turning complex business and regulatory needs into practical platform outcomes that improve customer and operational experience.
  • Energised by collaborating across business, operations, technology and vendor teams to resolve ambiguity and deliver shared outcomes.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, multi-market environment requiring structured analysis, prioritisation, sound judgement and disciplined follow-through.
  • Driven by learning platform functionality and technical flows deeply enough to challenge solutions constructively and make informed product decisions.
  • Demonstrates resilience and ownership when managing competing priorities, delivery dependencies, regulatory deadlines and production risks.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or equivalent role delivering complex application changes in financial services.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering requirements, writing change requests or user stories, reviewing functional designs and securing stakeholder sign-off.
  • Experience coordinating vendors and cross-functional technology teams through testing, release and production implementation.
  • Knowledge of system integration patterns and experience defining clear integration specifications for upstream and downstream systems.
  • Proven ability to resolve ambiguity, evaluate trade-offs and lead stakeholder discussions towards agreed decisions and successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrates learning agility, self-motivation and resourcefulness by quickly building domain knowledge, proactively closing knowledge gaps, and making effective use of available people, information and tools to drive outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of wealth management, investment products, order management, client communications or regulatory reporting is highly preferred.

Certifications/Qualifications

  • No mandatory certification. Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience required; Agile or Product Owner certification is advantageous.

Languages

  • Full proficiency English & Mandarin to support business needs in specific market.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Role Overview

The Mission of the role is to lead the transformation of our digital products, evolving them into Data-Driven and AI-enabled digital channel experiences.

In This Role, You Will

  • End-to-End product ownership: Own the full lifecycle of assigned digital products, ensuring the digital experience are intuitive, easy-to-use, robust, and fulfill business purpose.
  • Strategic Alignment: Ensure digital capabilities and journeys to align with IWPB Omni Channel Strategy and Wealth Transformation strategy.
  • Agile Evolution & Commercial Value: Lead the continuous evolution of the digital capabilities and journeys through a "test and learn" approach, delivering commercially successful outcomes and measurable ROI.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Maintain a deep understanding of customer & frontline pain points, wealth management market trends, and emerging AI/tech capabilities to define a forward-looking digital product strategy
  • Capability Enhancement: Identify and drive improvement opportunities that enhance customer and frontline experiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Distribution, Proposition and Technology teams to develop/enhance digital capabilities, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of the customers and business.
  • Culture & Leadership: Act as a catalyst for a customer-centric and simplification culture.
  • External Benchmarking: Proactively engage with external partners and industry bodies to monitor market trends, adapting the digital product roadmap to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify and manage key risks, issues, and interdependencies, applying robust mitigation to protect the bank and the brand.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Digital Transformation Track Record: Proven experience delivering digital transformation with tangible business outcomes within financial services
  • Agile & Design Thinking: Extensive experience with User-Centered Design, rapid prototyping, and delivering products within an Agile environment.
  • Full Product Lifecycle: Demonstrated expertise in opportunity identification, business case creation, requirements definition, cross-functional deployment, project execution, launch, and post-launch performance management.
  • Tech Fluency: Strong technical aptitude with the ability to translate business and frontline needs into precise IT and AI requirements.
  • Platform Versatility: Exposure to diverse technical landscapes, including digital front-ends, internal user facing systems, and various backend systems to ensure seamless integration for target journeys.
  • Strategic Thought Leadership: Creative and proactive in proposing new business opportunities and solving complex customer or operational challenges.
  • Project Management: Competent in project planning, reporting, and managing shifting or competing priorities with flexibility.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to build strong relationships and influence large, cross-functional teams, including those with direct leadership authority.
  • Decision Making: Capable of sharing responsibility for key decisions while driving internal decision-making processes to a conclusion.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong analytical and presentation skills to drive data-backed decisions.
  • Attitude: Energetic, positive, and a collaborative team player.
  • Flexibility: A flexible approach to work, adaptable to changing business hours and priorities.
  • Language: Fluent in English is a plus
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is preferable.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. The Trader is a senior level position responsible for overseeing a trading book and managing book risk, in coordination with the Trading team. The overall objective of this role is to ensure book trades deliver on budgeted revenues, and to coordinate with key stakeholders to develop the trading franchise.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee a trading book and generate revenues and manage risk for the respective business
  • Coordinate with Sales, Research and other organizations across broader business
  • Trade a book and deliver on budgeted revenues and manage book risk
  • Establish and maintain key relationships to deliver trades to the desk
  • Anticipate client demand in each respective product/market
  • Coordinate with desk analysts as needed and with sales to develop the franchise
  • Leading strong governance and controls:
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
  • Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 6-10 years of experience in a related role
  • Knowledge of respective products and clients
  • Required CSRC licensing and registrations as applicable
  • Advance analytical and numerical competency
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Effective interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to analyze and pitch situations and determine suitable counterparties
  • Knowledge of Bloomberg, booking systems, trading protocol, closing technicalities

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

The Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer in Group AI Platforms, you’ll shape the technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for HSBC’s next-generation AI platform. You’ll help establish the engineering foundations that enable AI capabilities to be delivered reliably, securely and at scale across the Bank.

The role will focus on strengthening the resilience, scalability, performance and operability of core AI platform services, including the AI Gateway, security guardrails, model hosting and related foundation services. These capabilities are designed to provide dependable, always-on access to AI models and services across business applications—much like essential electricity infrastructure: consistently available when needed and capable of supporting high levels of demand.

You’ll help define the target architecture and engineering standards for a unified gateway ecosystem spanning LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway and Agent Gateway, alongside Guardrails as a Service. You’ll also identify and adopt relevant advances in AI and cloud-native engineering to ensure the platform remains secure, efficient and fit for the evolving needs of the Bank.

As a senior technical authority, you’ll establish engineering best practice, drive adoption across platform delivery teams and raise the standard for production readiness. You’ll champion AI-native development practices that improve delivery efficiency, software quality and engineering decision-making—while ensuring that human accountability, security, resilience and responsible use remain central.

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design,
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Associate 2 Fund Administrator will be responsible for independently processing investment activity on custody and/or accounting entries, preparing accurate and timely reconciliations integral to the completion of the Net Asset Value (NAV) that is used for alternative investment funds, Investor dealing and external publication, plus various other client specific reports distributed on a regular basis. Why Is This Role Important To Us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), recognized provider of fund accounting and/or administration services to Alternative Investment Asset Owner clients globally. Our Asset Owner Clients entrust us with the critical responsibility of managing the operational backbone that supports their investment portfolios. This role is central to ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and transparency of key services—such as document management, cash processing, valuation, and performance reporting—that directly impact client confidence and investment decision-making.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Fund Administrator Associate 2 you will:

  • Performance daily workflow independently and timely
  • Assisting with the accurate and timely production of the Net Asset Value
  • Verifying and ensuring all events have been processed accurately
  • Processing and reviewing various funds and/or investments’ activity on custodian & accounting
  • Supervising investigation and resolution of all reconciling cash and position items
  • Coordinating with other departments on miscellaneous fund queries and reconciliations
  • Assist in the preparation of operational activities related to document management, cash processing, valuation reconciliation, investment set up and performance reporting to support the delivery of accurate and timely services to asset owner clients.
  • Demonstrate working ability on MS office apps including Excel etc.
  • Assisting with training and development of staff
  • Execute key controls and promptly escalate identified issues
  • Participate in system testing, automation, and process improvement activities when assigned


What We Value

This position offers the successful candidate the opportunity to broaden their knowledge of private equity, private credit, and other alternative investments operating in a dynamic, deadline sensitive environment. The candidate will contribute to the development of the team, job staff training, liaising with external parties and enhancing client satisfaction.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Business, Accounting or related field.
  • Approx 2 years’ related experience in a fund accounting environment, including knowledge of cash and position reconciliation in funds
  • Knowledge of unlisted products such as Private equity, real estate, etc.
  • Knowledge of custody cash payment/ receipt will be an advantage
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong numerical / analytical skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly computer literate
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Organized and Deadline-driven
  • Good team player, with supervisory experience a distinct advantage
  • Assist in the preparation of operational activities related to document management, cash processing, valuation reconciliation, and performance reporting to support the delivery of accurate and timely services to asset owner clients.
